Insights Page Implementation Plan ​

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Extend the Insights page with priority tiers (high/low), tax-efficiency insight cards, and an opt-in Claude API chat box at the bottom.

Architecture: The existing insights router generates rule-based insight cards. This plan adds priority tiers to each insight, adds tax-efficiency and liquidity insights, and adds a /api/insights/chat endpoint that proxies to Claude using backend/ai.py (created in Foundation plan). The frontend adds a chat UI that only renders when the API key is configured.

Tech Stack: Python/FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, backend/ai.py (Claude SDK), React 18, TypeScript

Add the following imports to backend/routers/insights.py:

from pydantic import BaseModel
from .. import ai as ai_module

Append to backend/routers/insights.py:

python
class ChatMessage(BaseModel):
    message: str


@router.get("/chat/status")
def chat_status():
    return {"configured": ai_module.is_configured()}


@router.post("/chat")
def chat(body: ChatMessage, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    if not ai_module.is_configured():
        return {"configured": False, "reply": None}

    accounts = db.query(Account).all()
    portfolio_summary = {}
    for a in accounts:
        total = sum((h.last_price or 0) * h.quantity for h in a.holdings)
        if total > 0:
            portfolio_summary[a.name] = {"type": a.type, "value": round(total, 2)}

    profile = {
        "monthly_expenses": _get_setting(db, "monthly_expenses"),
        "risk_profile": _get_setting(db, "risk_profile"),
        "income_w2": _get_setting(db, "income_w2"),
        "tax_filing_status": _get_setting(db, "tax_filing_status"),
    }

    try:
        reply = ai_module.chat(body.message, context={"portfolio": portfolio_summary, "profile": profile})
        return {"configured": True, "reply": reply}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"configured": True, "reply": None, "error": str(e)}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useApi } from '../hooks/useApi'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { Insight, ChatStatus, ChatResponse } from '../types'

const CATEGORY_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  'Risk': '#c95f52',
  'Performance': '#c9a96e',
  'Tax Efficiency': '#5cad7a',
  'Liquidity': '#6a9fc0',
  'Trends': '#9b85c4',
  'Real Estate': '#c9a96e',
}

function InsightCard({ insight }: { insight: Insight }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)
  const color = CATEGORY_COLOR[insight.category] ?? '#5c5444'

  return (
    <div
      className="card"
      style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${color}`, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 12 }}
      onClick={() => setExpanded(e => !e)}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
              {insight.category}
            </span>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 10, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4,
              background: insight.priority === 'high' ? 'rgba(201,95,82,0.15)' : 'rgba(92,84,68,0.2)',
              color: insight.priority === 'high' ? '#c95f52' : '#5c5444',
            }}>
              {insight.priority}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 14 }}>{insight.title}</div>
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-3)', fontSize: 12 }}>{expanded ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
      </div>

      {expanded && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-2)', marginBottom: 8 }}>{insight.description}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-3)', marginBottom: insight.action ? 12 : 0 }}>
            <strong style={{ color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>Why:</strong> {insight.why}
          </div>
          {insight.action && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#5cad7a', background: 'rgba(92,173,122,0.08)', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 6, borderLeft: '2px solid #5cad7a' }}>
              <strong>Action:</strong> {insight.action}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function ChatBox() {
  const { data: status } = useApi<ChatStatus>(() => api.get('/insights/chat/status'), [])
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<{ role: 'user' | 'assistant'; text: string }[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  if (!status?.configured) {
    return (
      <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 32, opacity: 0.6 }}>
        <div className="section-label mb-8">AI Chat</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>
          Add <code>CLAUDE_API_KEY</code> to your <code>.env</code> file to enable personalized AI financial advice.
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  async function send() {
    if (!message.trim()) return
    const userMsg = message.trim()
    setMessage('')
    setHistory(h => [...h, { role: 'user', text: userMsg }])
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const resp = await api.post<ChatResponse>('/insights/chat', { message: userMsg })
      if (resp.reply) {
        setHistory(h => [...h, { role: 'assistant', text: resp.reply! }])
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: 32 }}>
      <div className="section-label mb-16">Ask about your finances</div>
      <div style={{ minHeight: 80, maxHeight: 320, overflowY: 'auto', marginBottom: 12 }}>
        {history.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-3)', fontSize: 13 }}>
            Ask anything: "Am I too heavy in tech?", "What should I do before year-end?", "How's my emergency fund?"
          </div>
        )}
        {history.map((m, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{
            marginBottom: 10,
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: 6,
            background: m.role === 'user' ? 'var(--card-2)' : 'transparent',
            fontSize: 13,
            lineHeight: 1.5,
          }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-3)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
              {m.role === 'user' ? 'You' : 'Claude'}
            </div>
            {m.text}
          </div>
        ))}
        {loading && (
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-3)', fontSize: 13, padding: '8px 12px' }}>Thinking…</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        <input
          value={message}
          onChange={e => setMessage(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && send()}
          placeholder="Ask a question…"
          style={{ flex: 1, background: 'var(--bg)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, padding: '8px 12px', color: 'var(--text)', fontSize: 13 }}
        />
        <button
          onClick={send}
          disabled={loading || !message.trim()}
          style={{ padding: '8px 16px', background: 'var(--card-2)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text)', fontSize: 13 }}
        >
          Send
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function InsightsPage() {
  const { data, loading } = useApi<Insight[]>(() => api.get('/insights/'), [])
  const insights = data ?? []

  const high = insights.filter(i => i.priority === 'high')
  const low = insights.filter(i => i.priority === 'low')

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="page-title">Insights</h1>

      {loading && <div className="empty"><div className="empty-sub">Analyzing…</div></div>}

      {!loading && insights.length === 0 && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-sub">Import some data to generate insights</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {high.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <div className="section-label mb-12">Action required</div>
          {high.map((ins, i) => <InsightCard key={i} insight={ins} />)}
        </div>
      )}

      {low.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div className="section-label mb-12">Observations</div>
          {low.map((ins, i) => <InsightCard key={i} insight={ins} />)}
        </div>
      )}

      <ChatBox />
    </div>
  )
}
